companyName: Natural Gas Pipeline Company of America (NGPL)
rationale: The census holding is not a new company. It is the same regulated U.S. interstate pipeline and storage operator already published as Natural Gas Pipeline Co. of America. The queue missed the match because its normalizer did not equate the terminal NGPL acronym and Company/Co. wording. Preserve the existing production ID, correct the canonical legal name and aliases, and replace the single unspecified ArcLight owner row with complete current and former ownership periods. Current direct economic ownership is ArcLight-managed funds at 62.5% and Kinder Morgan at 37.5%; Kinder Morgan remains operator. Brookfield completed the sale of its remaining 25% on May 13, 2025 and is a former owner. No NGPL-specific sale or pending exit was identified through August 13, 2026. DigitalBridge's announced acquisition of ArcLight is a manager-level transaction and does not make DigitalBridge a direct NGPL owner.

operatingResolution.footprint: Approximately 9,105 miles of pipeline and 288 Bcf of working gas storage as of December 31, 2025, spanning nine states and linking major U.S. supply basins with Midwest and Gulf Coast markets.
operatingResolution.services: Firm, flexible-firm and interruptible natural-gas transportation; multiple firm and interruptible storage services; balancing; park-and-loan; and line-pack services.

acquisitionExitCheck.incrementalArcLightAcquisition: ArcLight acquired an additional 12.5% on June 15, 2023, increasing its interest to 37.5%.
acquisitionExitCheck.brookfieldExit: Brookfield signed the sale of its remaining 25% on March 21, 2025. ArcLight announced completion on May 13, 2025, raising ArcLight-managed ownership to 62.5%, and Brookfield later reported that its remaining U.S. gas-pipeline interest had been sold.
acquisitionExitCheck.currentOwnership: Kinder Morgan's 2025 Form 10-K reports a 37.5% interest. Kinder Morgan's current NGPL overview states that Kinder Morgan indirectly owns 37.5%, operates the company and ArcLight-controlled funds own the remaining 62.5%.
acquisitionExitCheck.subsequentExitSearch: No later NGPL equity sale, pending exit or direct incoming buyer was identified through August 13, 2026.
